details.acceptedBaseline: Matches the mission's documented pre-existing Vitest baseline for frontend validation.

details.note: The lint command now exits cleanly; error count improved below the mission's accepted baseline of 10 errors.

blockingIssues.description: `part64/frontend/src/App.tsx` mounts `useMuseHandlers` twice, so incoming agent events are processed twice and can duplicate toasts/overlay side effects.

Slash-command and autopilot flows are wired to the bootstrap `muse` hook instance while the UI mutates `museWithDeps`, leaving command execution and workspace context stale relative to the visible selection.

Frontend runtime code still calls removed backend routes such as `/api/muse/*` and `/api/witness*` in `useAgentHandlers.ts`, `ThreatRadarPanel.tsx`, `Chat.tsx`, `Canvas.tsx`, and `useChatCommandHandlers.ts`, so checked-in agent/continuity flows do not match the renamed backend contract.

Frontend live-event handling still listens for legacy `muse.*` event kinds and legacy payload fields like `eventPayload.daimoi`, so renamed backend runtime events such as `agent.turn.completed` are ignored or misread.

The React app still renders the removed galaxy/vignette backdrop path: `CoreBackdrop.tsx` keeps `simulation-galaxy-layer-*` and `simulation-core-vignette`, and `App.tsx` still computes their parallax transforms.
`CoreControlPanel.tsx` still exposes an `edge vignette` control even though the vignette styling was removed, leaving a user-facing control for a deleted effect.

User-visible system messages in `useAgentHandlers.ts` still contain `muse` wording (`muse fallback active`, `muse turn signal`, `muse media action`, `muse request failed`), so narrative terminology remains visible in the frontend.
`PresenceCallDeck.tsx` still renders the panel heading `Presence Call Deck` instead of the requested `Particle Deck`, leaving inconsistent visible naming for the same panel.

Several frontend tests still use legacy narrative-era test scaffolding strings such as `set mouse daimon`, `Witness Thread`, `muse-presence-*`, and `lazy-daimoi-panel`, so the test suite was not fully renamed to the milestone's target terminology.

`useWorldPanelManager.ts` still performs a render-time `coreFlightVelocityRef.current` read and suppresses `react-hooks/refs` with an inline eslint disable instead of implementing the requested ref-safe fix.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated `.factory/library/architecture.md` to reflect the decomposed frontend shell, the current large frontend modules, and the mixed renamed-path/legacy-payload API contract.

Updated `.factory/library/environment.md` with the checked-in `part64/frontend/.env.local` overrides (`VITE_RUNTIME_BASE_URL`, `VITE_WEAVER_BASE_URL`) and their effect on frontend test/runtime URL expectations.

Updated `.factory/library/naming-map.md` to note that `/api/agent/*` path renames do not yet imply payload-field renames, because some handlers still accept `muse_id` and route through internal `muse` manager methods.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: For frontend features, require handoffs to record every required validator actually run (typecheck, test, lint when applicable) and forbid `followedProcedure: true` when those commands are omitted from evidence.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Reviews for `decompose-app-tsx`, `overhaul-css`, and `strip-narrative-labels` each found worker handoffs claiming procedure compliance despite missing required frontend validator evidence.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Rename-focused frontend work should explicitly grep runtime API paths, websocket/event kinds, and payload keys in addition to type names, file names, and display labels.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: `rename-frontend-types-and-files` passed its local rename checks but still left checked-in `/api/muse/*`, `/api/witness*`, `muse.*`, and `eventPayload.daimoi` residues in runtime code.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add concrete guidance for fixing `react-hooks/refs` violations in render-path React code, and explicitly disallow satisfying the task by silencing the rule with inline eslint disables.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: `fix-eslint-regression-frontend` reduced lint errors but left a render-time ref read in `useWorldPanelManager.ts` behind an inline `react-hooks/refs` suppression.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Label-cleanup features should verify both container-derived labels and panel-internal headings/status strings before handoff.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: `strip-narrative-labels` updated outer panel labels, but `PresenceCallDeck.tsx` still rendered `Presence Call Deck` and `useAgentHandlers.ts` still emitted visible `muse` status strings.

rejectedObservations.observation: The shared architecture note was stale because it still described a monolithic `App.tsx`.
The repo's shared environment notes were missing the effect of `part64/frontend/.env.local` on Vitest/runtime URL behavior.
The naming guidance did not capture that renamed `/api/agent/*` paths still use legacy payload keys like `muse_id`.
Multiple reviews separately flagged missing validator evidence in worker handoffs.
rejectedObservations.reason: Deduplicated into one systemic `refactor-worker` guidance recommendation instead of recording the same process issue multiple times.
